findings.title: Installation proceeds without verifying the installer when no integration exists yet
findings.body: When the installation record has not been created by the webhook yet, this branch advances the pipeline without checking the authenticated GitHub user. The next step can create the integration, so a callback racing ahead of webhook processing bypasses the installer-identity check entirely. Verify the sender through a reliable source before advancing, or fail/retry until that identity is available.

findings.title: GitHub OAuth request failures escape the installation error flow
findings.body: The token exchange and subsequent `get_user_info` call are outside any error handling. If GitHub rejects the code with an HTTP error, or the `/user` request fails (for example, a rejected token or transient API error), these calls can raise instead of returning the installation failure response. This produces an unhandled error rather than the failure screen promised for invalid or reused codes; catch the relevant request/API exceptions and route them through `error()`.
